incidents.summary: Legal & General and Pimco were sued by the owner of Brussels’ Finance Tower amid allegations that they placed undue pressure on property valuers.

sources.title: Pimco, L&G Sued Over €1.2 Billion Brussels Skyscraper Valuation - Bloomberg
sources.quote: Pimco and Legal & General Group Plc have been accused of placing “undue pressure” on property valuers in a bitter scrap over the future of a famous Brussels skyscraper whose owner has collapsed into insolvency.

sources.title: Pimco, L&G Sued Over €1.2 Billion Brussels Skyscraper Valuation - Bloomberg
sources.quote: The owner of The Finance Tower, the 142 meter (466 feet) high building located in downtown Brussels, filed a lawsuit in the English High Court in a bid to to stall an attempt by its lenders to freeze rental income, according to documents lodged in London and New York courts.

incidents.summary: XTX Markets sued Legal & General Investment Management and Aviva Investors, alleging that they refused its investment because of its Russian owner.

sources.title: Aviva Investors and LGIM sued over alleged Russian discrimination
sources.quote: Financial trading group XTX Markets has issued a lawsuit against Aviva Investors and Legal & General Investment Management over allegations they refused to allow the group to invest in their funds due to its Russian owner.

positives: LGIM divested from Glencore and TJX under its climate engagement programme.
